doomsdayClock.context: Banner at the top of the lair dashboard. Keep it short; {{minutes}} is a number.

emptyState.context: Shown when there are no schemes. Playful, one sentence.

selfDestruct.confirm.context: Destructive confirm dialog. {{minutes}} is the countdown length.

camerasPrivacyNote.context: {{days}} is the retention period. Joke: the minions have a union.

heroInLair.context: Toast. {{hero}} is the hero's name; keep the <b> tags around it.

promoteConfirm.context: Confirm dialog. Keep the <b> tags around the name.

reviewSaved.context: Toast. {{name}} is the minion's name. Dry joke: they were told it went well.

foiledBy.context: {{hero}} is a superhero's name. Weary tone.

riskHint.context: Tooltip on the risk level field. {{distance}} is a number.

approvalsHelp.context: Help text under the approval section. {{amount}} is a formatted currency amount.

approvalRejected.context: Joke: the boss rejected the scheme as unoriginal.

unsavedChanges.body.context: Confirm dialog when leaving an edited form. The sidekick line is a joke; keep the dry tone.

pagination.pageOf.context: Table footer. {{page}} is the current page number, {{total}} the number of pages.

itemArchived.context: Toast after archiving. {{name}} is the name of a scheme, device or lair.

twoFactor.prompt.context: Shown above the code input. The 'evil' authenticator is a joke; keep it short.

magicLinkSent.context: {{minutes}} is always 15 or more, so the plural form is safe.

inviteTitle.context: {{name}} is the inviting person, {{lair}} the workspace (lair) name.

signUpTerms.context: Below the sign-up button. Keep the <a> tags around the terms link text.

fileTooLarge.context: {{file}} is the file name, {{size}} a whole number of megabytes.

deathRayCooldown.context: Shown when firing is rate-limited. {{minutes}} is always 2 or more.

maintenanceBody.context: Full-page maintenance notice. {{time}} is a clock time like 14:00, {{timezone}} its abbreviation.

timeZoneHint.context: {{city}} is a city from the time zone list, {{time}} a clock time like 14:05.

apiKeyShownOnce.context: Shown once after creating an API key, above the copy button. The key itself is not part of this string.

deleteLairConfirm.context: Confirm dialog. Keep the <b> tags around the lair name.

seatsHenchmanNote.context: Joke: only henchmen are billed per seat, minions are not.

cardEnding.context: {{last4}} is the last four digits of the saved card.

ransomPending.context: {{city}} is the city paying the ransom; {{amount}} is already formatted with its currency.

makeItRain.context: Main action button. {{city}} is the target city's name.

sunshineWarning.context: Joke: good weather is bad news for a villain.

privacyNotice.context: <a> links to the full privacy notice; keep the tags around the link text.

deviceDisclaimer.context: {{device}} is the name of a doomsday device, e.g. a death ray model.

hideHeroSafe.context: Checkbox in the catalogue filters. Hero-safe means the gadget cannot harm a hero; most villains filter these out.

gadget.deathRay.description.context: Joke: villains always monologue before firing. Keep it deadpan.

gadget.doomsdayStarter.description.context: Overlord is the name of the top paid plan.

borrowedToast.context: Toast after borrowing. {{device}} is the gadget name, e.g. Freeze Ray Mk II.

upgradeForDoomsday.context: The <a> tag links to the billing page. Overlord is the plan name.

specs.heroResistance.context: How well heroes usually resist this gadget. Lower is better for the villain.

warranty.voidHeroes.context: Joke: the whole point of the gadget is to be used against heroes. Keep the dry, small-print tone.

recall.acknowledge.context: Button confirming the user read the recall notice. Plays on 'step slowly away' in the notice text.

shrinkRayUndo.context: Help text under the shrink ray's fire button. {{minutes}} is a number, usually 5.

cancelOrderConfirm.context: Confirm dialog. {{device}} is the gadget name. 'The grudge' is a joke; keep it short.

reviewRating.context: Rating shown on reviews. Skulls replace stars. {{amount}} can be a decimal like 4.5.

sampleReview.context: Sample minion review shown on the freeze ray page.

profile.lastSeen.context: {{city}} is an invented city name, such as Gravenport.

contractDentalPlan.context: Contract perk in a checklist. A joke; keep the aside in brackets.

assignSuccess.context: Toast. {{name}} is the henchman, {{scheme}} the scheme title.

target.museum.context: Gravenport is an invented city. Keep the name, translate the rest.

vault.sentientDoor.context: Vault type. The door is alive and can be bribed; a joke.

heistFoiled.context: Toast. {{hero}} is a hero's name, {{target}} a building such as the Grand Museum of Gravenport.

ransomDemand.context: Button in the ransom note composer. {{amount}} is a formatted sum, {{date}} the deadline.

heroTauntReceived.context: Notification preview. {{hero}} is the sender; keep the <b> tags around the quote. The cliché is on purpose.

progress.context: Wizard progress indicator above the step title. {{step}} is the current step number, {{total}} the number of steps.

inviteMinion.help.context: {{email}} is the invitee's address, {{lair}} the lair name chosen in step 1.

nemesisSelected.context: {{hero}} is a hero's name. The joke: we are not sure the hero got the message.

subtitle.context: {{month}} is a localised month and year, e.g. March 2026.

ransomTotal.context: {{amount}} is a formatted sum of money; {{change}} is a signed percentage such as +12 %.

quarterlySummary.context: Generated summary paragraph at the top of the quarterly review. Dry, managerial tone.

heroSpotted.context: Toast title. {{hero}} is a hero's name, {{city}} a city name.

digest.subjectWeekly.context: Email subject line. {{count}} is the total number of schemes, {{foiled}} how many heroes stopped. Keep it under about 60 characters if you can.

pushDisabled.context: The <a> link opens the browser's notification permission prompt.
